role_desc: A Full-Stack Developer specializing in building optimized, user-centric web applications. Stepping away from the screen, I am a passionate photographer, applying my attention to detail and aesthetic eye to capture meaningful moments.
proj_warehouse_desc_full: A comprehensive Warehouse & Shipping Management (B2C) system designed to track inventory, manage order lifecycles, oversee suppliers, and process returns. The system features role-based access control (RBAC), real-time stock validation, and integrates automated batch jobs to optimize operations.
feature_wh_1: Authentication & Security: JWT-based authentication with refresh token rotation, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and comprehensive audit trails.
feature_wh_2: Order & Inventory Management: Real-time stock visibility, automatic inventory reservation, and inter-location stock transfers.
feature_wh_3: Shipping & Carrier Integration: End-to-end shipment lifecycle management, shipping label generation, and real-time tracking via API.
feature_wh_4: System Automation: Automated background processes to optimize system health, including stale order auto-cancellation and low-stock alerts.
feature_wh_5: Returns & Procurement: Full supplier purchase order lifecycle management and structured returns processing.
feature_wh_6: Reporting & Dashboard: Admin dashboards with KPI metrics, exportable reports for inventory summaries and revenue analytics.
contrib_wh_1: UI/UX Design: Designed high-fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes, and user-centric interfaces using Figma.
contrib_wh_2: Front-end Development: Translated Figma designs into responsive, interactive, and pixel-perfect web pages using NextJS.
proj_todo_desc_full: .NET platform for managing a list of all tasks to do. Built with a 3-Layer Architecture (Forms, Services, Repository).
feature_td_1: User authentication: Users can register and log in securely to manage their personal data.
feature_td_2: Task management (CRUD): Allows users to create, update, delete, and view tasks.
feature_td_3: Category management: Organizes and classifies tasks into different goal groups.
feature_td_4: Admin dashboard: Allows admin to manage the list of all users and all tasks in the system.
resp_td_2: Built features and handled logic for user functions (register, login, task management) and a centralized Admin dashboard.
proj_coffee_desc_full: A comprehensive web-based management system designed for coffee shop operations and business management. The application provides an integrated platform for managing menu items, customer orders, user accounts, and generating revenue reports. Built with modern ASP.NET Core technologies, it streamlines daily operations while offering a user-friendly interface for staff and administrators.
feature_cf_1: User Authentication: User registration and secure login with role-based access control.
feature_cf_2: Drink & Category Management: Create, update, delete, and view coffee products and categories.
feature_cf_3: Order Management: Create and track customer orders with status tracking (Pending → In Progress → Completed → Paid).
feature_cf_4: Search Functionality: Search orders by order ID, table number, and customer information.
feature_cf_5: Pagination: Display data in pages with 5 items per page for better organization.
feature_cf_6: Revenue Reports: View sales analytics and transaction history for business insights.
feature_cf_7: Data Security: Soft-delete functionality to preserve data and account lockout after failed login attempts.
